mentions.name: numa
mentions.description: This is numa, a DNS-over-HTTPS resolver. Version 0.13.0 adds request hedging that fires a parallel query after 10ms if the primary stalls (inspired by Google's Tail at Scale paper), a wire-level cache with serve-stale support (RFC 8767), and a DoT client for encrypted upstream, addressing tail latency in DoH query handling.
mentions.problem: Tail latency in DNS-over-HTTPS resolution, with the project shipping fixes and a write-up of the investigation.
